problem:
The data in the table below shows the percent of bus riders in a survey of Central H.S. students; 300 males and 300 females in each grade were surveyed. For which grade is the number of its male bus riders closest to $135\%$ of the number of its female bus riders? \begin{tabular}{|l|c|c|}\hline
Grade & Males & Females \\ \hline
$9^{\mathrm{th}}$ grade & $41.1\%$ & $39.4\%$ \\ \hline
$10^{\mathrm{th}}$ grade & $34.4\%$ & $33.1\%$ \\ \hline
$11^{\mathrm{th}}$ grade & $20.6\%$ & $13.8\%$ \\ \hline
$12^{\mathrm{th}}$ grade & $11.6\%$ & $8.6\%$ \\ \hline
\end{tabular}
submitted_text:
Step 1: Calculate the number of male and female bus riders for each grade based on the given percentages and the sample size of 300 for each gender.

Step 2: For the 9th grade:
- Male bus riders: \(300 \times 41.1\% = 300 \times 0.411 = 123.3\)
- Female bus riders: \(300 \times 39.4\% = 300 \times 0.394 = 118.2\

Step 3: For the 10th grade:
- Male bus riders: \(300 \times 34.4\% = 300 \times 0.344 = 103.2\)
- Female bus riders: \(300 \times 33.1\% = 300 \times 0.331 = 99.3\)

Step 4: For the 11th grade:
- Male bus riders: \(300 \times 20.6\% = 300 \times 0.206 = 61.8\)
- Female bus riders: \(300 \times 13.8\% = 300 \times 0.138 = 41.4\)

Step 5: For the 12th grade:
- Male bus riders: \(300 \times 11.6\% = 300 \times 0.116 = 34.8\)
- Female bus riders: \(300 \times 8.6\% = 300 \times 0.086 = 25.8\)

Step 6: Check if the number of male bus riders is closest to 135% of the number of female bus riders for each grade.

Step 7: For the 9th grade:
- 135% of female bus riders: \(118.2 \times 1.35 = 159.07\)
- Difference: \(159.07 - 123.3 = 35.77\)

Step 8: For the 10th grade:
- 135% of female bus riders: \(99.3 \times 1.35 = 134.455\)
- Difference: \(134.455 - 103.2 = 31.255\)

Step 9: For the 11th grade:
- 135% of female bus riders: \(41.4 \times 1.35 = 55.89\)
- Difference: \(55.89 - 61.8 = -5.91\) (or 5.91 when considering absolute value)

Step 10: For the 12th grade:
- 135% of female bus riders: \(25.8 \times 1.35 = 34.83\)
- Difference: \(34.83 - 34.8 = 0.03\)

Final answer: \boxed{12th grade}
